description:
## Why This Exists

tls.rs::check_cert_expiry() emits a warning/error log and updates the Prometheus gauge when TLS certificate is within 30/7 days of expiry. It is called at startup and on /reload. However, a server that runs continuously for months after startup will not emit the warning until /reload is manually triggered. Operators relying on alerting off the Prometheus gauge or tracing logs will miss the expiry window.

## Acceptance Criteria

Schedule a periodic task (e.g. every 24h) that calls check_cert_expiry and updates the gauge. The task should be cancellable on shutdown.
title: tls.rs: check_cert_expiry called at startup only; no periodic recheck
